tools.name: validate_identifier
tools.description: Validate a Brazilian identifier: CPF, CNPJ (numeric or alphanumeric), EAN-13 barcode, NF-e access key or phone number. Price: $0.005 (USDC on Base via x402).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Brazilian company registration data by CNPJ: legal name, status, address, partners (QSA), CNAE activities, capital. Price: $0.01.

tools.name: get_company_score
tools.description: Explainable health/risk score 0-100 for a Brazilian company (KYB / supplier triage), with the factors and flags behind it. Not a credit score. Price: $0.02.

tools.name: get_company_dossier
tools.description: Full Brazilian company dossier: registration data, signals and health score in one call. Price: $0.10.

tools.name: batch_company_score
tools.description: Health/risk score for up to 10 Brazilian CNPJs in one call (supplier/customer list triage). Price: $0.015 per valid CNPJ; invalid-format entries are not billed.

tools.name: decode_boleto
tools.description: Validate and decode a Brazilian boleto: digitable line (47 cobranca / 48 arrecadacao) or barcode (44). Returns bank, amount, due date (flags ambiguity from the Febraban 2025 factor reset) and check-digit results. Price: $0.005.

tools.name: decode_pix
tools.description: Validate and decode a PIX copia-e-cola (BR Code): CRC16, key and key type, merchant name and city, amount, txid, static or dynamic. Payload is not stored. Price: $0.005.

tools.name: lookup_cep
tools.description: Brazilian address by CEP (postal code): street, neighborhood, city, state, IBGE codes and coordinates when available. Price: $0.003.

tools.name: lookup_bank
tools.description: Brazilian bank by COMPE code or ISPB (Central Bank registry): short and full legal name. Provide code or ispb. Price: $0.002.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Brazilian business days (national holidays, including Carnaval and Corpus Christi; no state/municipal holidays). With only date: is it a business day and the next/previous one. With add: date after N business days. With end: business days between date (inclusive) and end (exclusive). Price: $0.003.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Current Brazilian indicators from the Central Bank (SGS): Selic target, CDI annual and daily, IPCA monthly and 12-month, USD/BRL sell. Each value with unit and reference date. Price: $0.005.

tools.name: about
tools.description: Free. What BR Intelligence does, prices per tool, payment network and documentation links.
